title: エンディング（ノーマル）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like I started working with Mejiro Dober just the other day, but three years is swiftly coming to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's left quite the indelible mark on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But this is far from the end of her journey, and in order to shine even brighter, she'll be pushing herself just as hard today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Whew. That should be good enough for a warm-up.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: You're so cool, Dober! You're the best racer ever!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: The levels of preciousness she and Bright share when they run together… I've been blessed this morning…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: You don't get nervous anymore, even when you're being watched.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I guess you're right. I couldn't stand having any eyes on me when we first met.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It feels like so long ago…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hmm. I must say, I don't think that's the biggest change in you, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Well, compared to three years ago…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You're far, far, faaar more honest with your trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wh-what? No, I'm not! What are you even talking about?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: B-Bright! Don't say it like that! It's embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Never mind! I've never thought anything about him, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Goodness, how terrifying! ♪ I'd best run for it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I can never get in a word against her…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Why I'm so different than I was three years ago.
